Homepage Studio — license provenance

Original Studio code:
Copyright (c) 2026 Ben.
Licensed under AGPL-3.0-or-later; see ../LICENSE. You may redistribute and
modify it under GNU Affero General Public License version 3, or (at your
option) any later version. It is provided without warranty; see the full
license terms.

Historical prototype:
Earlier copies were provided under MIT. Those permissions are not revoked.
The original notice is preserved in prototype-MIT-LICENSE. The original
prototype archive remains unchanged.

Homepage-derived material:
The native renderer and widget catalog derive from gethomepage/homepage
v2.6.0, commit 51cc1684f9f34a7877ed462b8f94c9cc687b4dde. Retain upstream
copyright and GPL-3.0 terms; see homepage-LICENSE and ../homepage/LICENSE.
The complete controlled fork is tracked under homepage/ and copied directly
into the single application build. The current Git source commit/tree binds
all Studio and native changes; upstream.lock.json retains baseline provenance.
Studio's original-code license does not broaden the upstream grant.
The catalog preserves source attribution and documentation example notices;
see catalog-NOTICE.txt. It is a catalog of native examples and known fields,
not a complete configuration schema or universal integration test.

YAML parser:
yaml 2.8.3 by Eemeli Aro is licensed under ISC. The exact installed notice is
preserved in yaml-LICENSE. Keep dependency notices in corresponding-source
and distribution artifacts.
Bundled fonts:
IBM Plex Mono retains its bundled SIL Open Font License notice, copied without
changes from homepage/src/styles/font/IBMPlexMono-LICENSE.txt to
IBMPlexMono-LICENSE.txt. Its original copyright and Reserved Font Name remain
intact. The font files are included in the controlled native source.

Manrope.ttf and Manrope.woff2 identify Manrope version 4.505 and retain this
embedded notice: Copyright 2019-2021 The Manrope Project Authors
(https://github.com/sharanda/manrope). Both embedded metadata records identify
the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1. Manrope-OFL.txt preserves the full
license and its source copyright notice (2018) without replacing either
historical notice with the other. It was verified from Google's fonts source:
https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/16c2976c68c3137c09c69c8e9d3deada699d157e/ofl/manrope/OFL.txt
SHA-256: 58172e0c0fac2cda8a37b348164bb55e44b0e69051e557e92b1d3f6910141f7b
The bundled font binaries and their embedded notices are unchanged.

The root Dockerfile copies this entire third-party directory into the runtime
image. The single corresponding-source archive includes these notices, the
complete native fork, font files, original license files and build definitions.

Shared native YAML parser:
js-yaml 5.4.3 is used by the native configuration reader and controller indexing
policy. Its installed MIT notice is preserved unchanged in js-yaml-LICENSE.
The shared parser source and exact dependency version are committed together.

Sign-in dependencies:
The sign-in and access-control layer (server/auth) uses @simplewebauthn/server
and @simplewebauthn/browser for passkeys, openid-client for single sign-on,
nodemailer for email and qrcode-generator for authenticator QR codes, with
their production dependencies. The installed license
texts of all of them are preserved unchanged in
sign-in-dependencies-LICENSES.txt. They are MIT, except asn1js (BSD-3-Clause),
nodemailer (MIT-0), reflect-metadata (Apache-2.0) and tslib (0BSD).
qrcode-generator is MIT licensed but ships no license file; that file says so.
